item.title: Allegations mount against D.C.’s only dedicated psychiatric hospital
item.description: WAMU speaks with reporter Luke Mullins about his latest investigation into allegations of abuse against staff and patients of the Psychiatric Institute of Washington

item.title: Trump says Democrats must cheat to win. What do his supporters think?
item.description: NPR spent several days traveling across a pair of swing districts in Pennsylvania to find out. The answers show how much has changed since the 2020 election.

item.title: Maryland is passing state and local laws to limit ICE. Will they hold up?
item.description: Maryland officials are pushing a slew of state and local measures curbing federal immigration enforcement. But legal experts say it's unclear whether state, local, or federal authority will ultimately prevail.

item.title: GOP lawmakers want to stop Arizona cities from imposing new taxes. Mayors say that’d be a problem
item.description: Arizona lawmakers are considering a pair of proposals that would stop cities and towns in Arizona from implementing new taxes or fees — or increasing ones they already have — through the end of June 2030.

item.title: Prairie Wind Ensemble presents free concert
item.description: On this week's episode of Out and About, Dr. Mae Gilliland of ArtsParnters talks with Dan Dietrich, trombonist with the Prairie Wind Ensemble, about their upcoming concert on March 19 at Five Points Washington. Founded in 1977, the ensemble brings together professional and hobbyist musicians from across Central Illinois to perform everything from classic marches to modern medleys. Dan shares why you don't want to miss this free concert full of energy!

item.title: Get Out There: ‘Shrimps on the Mountain’ with ‘Extended Family’ at Art Enables
item.description: For this week's Get Out There, we take you see to the exhibits at the nonprofit Art Enables in Brookland.

item.title: Hannah Maier Interviews Patty Yarmel – Strings For Success Founder
item.description: Patty Yarmel is one of the founding members of Strings For Success. She comes on Hannah Maier's show to talk about donations of stringed instruments and music in our schools month in Rochester NY

item.title: Second case of measles in Washtenaw County suspected
item.description: The Washtenaw County Health Department is suspecting a possible second case of measles in the area. WEMU's Ana Longoria reports.
